pure-announcement.rationale: A technical README describing an isolation architecture (privilege-separated agent user, lifecycle daemons, minimal hardened images), not launch or funding coverage, and the agents-in-purpose-built-VMs pattern transfers beyond this product.

duplicate.rationale: No nearest concept covers OS-image-level agent sandboxing; the closest, 'Automated W2S research sandbox', is about a research environment, not hardened agent runtime images.

unfalsifiable.rationale: The claims are the repo's own buildable artifacts — Nix build attributes, daemons, and options anyone can inspect and build.

durability.rationale: The transferable pattern (run agents in minimal hardened VMs with a restricted agent user) gets two sentences while the bulk is churn-prone specifics: build attribute names, a flake pinned to nixos-26.05, zstd flags, and a one-row mixtape table for a very young project.

actionability.rationale: Every concrete step is stereOS-specific (which Nix attribute to build, which option to set); a reader not adopting this exact distro takes away only the general isolation idea.

atomicity.rationale: It describes one thing — an agent-purposed OS image pipeline — and the core idea states cleanly in a paragraph without the README's tables.
